obligations.target: Launch Chromium and navigate to the application entry point to verify the page loads and renders successfully in an end-to-end smoke test.
obligations.reason: Verifying browser launch, navigation, and page rendering in Chromium requires an end-to-end browser test.

obligations.target: Verify that invoking the e2e-playwright runner automatically starts the application server and executes the browser test suite against the active application.
obligations.reason: Verifying that the web application automatically starts and the test suite executes successfully against it can only be observed by invoking the end-to-end runner.

obligations.target: Verify the continuous integration workflow configuration installs Chromium dependencies and executes the e2e-playwright runner job.
obligations.reason: CI workflow configuration and dependency installation steps are static pipeline configurations verified at the unit level.

obligations.target: Verify the test runner captures assertion failures and exits with a non-zero status code.
obligations.reason: Runner failure handling and non-zero exit status cannot be asserted inside a passing e2e suite and must be verified via unit tests.

obligations.target: Verify the runner detects when the web server fails to start or times out and terminates with an appropriate error.
obligations.reason: Application startup failure and error reporting cannot be executed within normal end-to-end test execution and is tested in an isolated unit test.
